I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November.

That comes from Ilse's 14 October message in #north-team, which Marcus can see himself because he's in the channel. Nothing has been posted since that changes it. There's no Brackenwater account file to check it against, so I named Ilse's message as the source for his account sheet.

A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share it with the North team in the channel.
